name: Pickup — Muros +5 (Raro)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo pickup centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 64×64.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon game collectible pickup item centered on a fully transparent background. The item is a floating RARE WALL CHARGE pickup showing 5 miniature cartoon wall blocks arranged in a cross/plus pattern (+), bright cyan-blue (#2288FF) with bold dark charcoal outlines, cel-shaded. A glowing golden ring (#FFD700) wraps the entire cross pattern, signaling rarity. Intense cyan-blue force-field energy aura around the blocks with small electric crackles. Each block has a glossy highlight on its top face. Golden sparkle stars float around it. Clearly bigger, brighter, and rarer than the 2-wall version. Unmistakably WALL TILES, not ammo. Transparent background, nothing else.
